services.name: UPS Next Day Air® Early
services.commitment: Guaranteed on-time, overnight delivery on business days by 8:00 a.m. to major cities in the 48 contiguous states and by 8:30 a.m., 9:00 a.m. or 9:30 a.m. to most other cities in the U.S.

services.name: UPS Next Day Air®
services.commitment: Guaranteed on-time delivery to all 50 states and Puerto Rico by 10:30 a.m., 12:00 p.m. or 3:00 p.m. the next business day.

services.name: UPS Next Day Air Saver®
services.tagline: Next-business-day delivery by end of day
services.commitment: Guaranteed on-time delivery to commercial destinations within the 48 contiguous states by 3:00 p.m. or 4:30 p.m. the next business day; to residences, by end of day.
services.delivered_by_default: End of Day next business day

services.name: UPS 2nd Day Air A.M.®
services.commitment: Guaranteed on-time delivery by 10:30 a.m. or 12:00 p.m. on the second business day to metropolitan commercial destinations in the 48 contiguous states.

services.name: UPS 2nd Day Air®
services.tagline: Second-business-day delivery by end of day
services.commitment: Guaranteed on-time delivery by end of day on the second business day to most U.S. addresses (commercial addresses in the 48 contiguous states).
services.delivered_by_default: End of Day second business day

services.name: UPS 3 Day Select®
services.tagline: Third-business-day delivery by end of day
services.commitment: Guaranteed delivery by end of day on the third business day to the 48 contiguous states.
services.delivered_by_default: End of Day third business day

services.name: UPS Ground
services.tagline: Cost-effective ground shipping within one to five business days
services.commitment: Delivers to all 50 states and Puerto Rico within one to five business days, with day-definite delivery by end of day; 85% of UPS Ground packages are delivered in three days or less.

services.name: UPS Ground Saver
services.tagline: Economy residential ground delivery, final mile by USPS
services.commitment: UPS's economical residential ground service; packages are tendered to the U.S. Postal Service for final-mile delivery.
